title.narrative: Africa Green, Resilient and Inclusive Housing De-Risking (GRIHD) Facility

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to increase private capital mobilization to expand access to green, resilient and inclusive housing for target beneficiaries in select countries in Eastern and Southern Africa.

The objective of the Green, Resilient and Inclusive Housing De-Risking (GRIHD) Facility Project is to increase private capital mobilization into green, resilient, and inclusive housing value chains in selected countries in Eastern and Southern Africa. There are two components to the project, the first component being catalyzing private capital for a green, resilient, and inclusive housing value chain. This component will support establishing, capitalizing, and operationalizing the Facility as a ring-fenced Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) within the Eastern and Southern African Trade and Development Bank (TDB) Group. This component includes two subcomponents: legal and operational readiness and sustainability of the GRIHD Facility and de-risking products for green, resilient, and inclusive housing value chains. The second component is the technical assistance. this component, whose funds will be ringfenced and implemented by the SPV, will address key institutional and technical capacity gaps within TDB and the SPV to adequately meet the Facility's mandate.
